question: Does local Clef choose the IPTC depth-1 Area more often right against the human level-2 labels than the embedding mapping, on MN-DS fresh2?
one_change: let local Clef pick the Area with two typed choices instead of the embedding similarity

baseline.model: embedding mapping with the reader constraint

prediction.metric: Clef exact level-2 match on fresh2
prediction.why: a 30-item pilot gave 0.30 for Clef against 0.267 for the embedding on the same items, too few to tell them apart; LLM choice on level-1 reached 0.60 in the pilot and the one-guess LLM against human topic labels was 0.707 over 49 topics, so level-2 over 100 or more terms should sit lower; the go bar for training a student is Clef minus embedding of 0.05 or more with the paired interval above zero
